# Ériu Sports

> Irish-run online shop selling fan replica retro football shirts, GAA county jerseys and training vests, AFL jerseys and kids football kits. Based in Ennis, Co. Clare, Ireland. Tracked delivery worldwide. Not affiliated with any club, county board, federation or kit brand.

## Key facts

- Prices are in euro with no VAT added. Retro football shirts from €25 (named and numbered shirts €35), GAA jerseys €29.95, GAA training vests €25, AFL jerseys €25, kids football kits €30 (named and numbered kids kits €35).
- Delivery: tracked, flat €5 worldwide, free on orders of €49 or more. Usually 10 to 16 days to Ireland and the UK (busy times like Christmas can add a few days); other countries vary. If an order hasn't arrived 30 days after ordering, we trace it or refund it.
- Customs: every order is sent duties paid, so there is nothing to pay on delivery.
- Weight: a football shirt weighs between 150g and 240g (about 5 to 8.5oz), depending on the size.
- Washing: machine wash warm, inside out, with no fabric softener or bleach. Take it out of the machine straight away and line dry; don't tumble dry. Touch up inside out with a cool iron, and don't dry clean.
- Returns: 30 days, unworn with tags on. The buyer pays return postage unless the item is faulty or not as described.
- Out of stock: if a shirt sells out after an order, we email the buyer and refund that item in full, plus any delivery charge paid, through PayPal within 14 days. The rest of the order still ships at no extra cost. No substitutes without the buyer's say-so.
- Payment: PayPal. Contact: noel@eriusports.com

## Shop

- [All shirts and jerseys](https://eriusports.com/catalog): search and filter the full range
- [Retro Irish Jerseys](https://eriusports.com/collections/ireland-classics): Ireland jerseys from Euro 88, Italia 90, USA 94 and the 2002 World Cup, Troy Parrott's 2026 Ireland 7, and League of Ireland jerseys from Bohemians (Fontaines D.C.) and Cork City
- [Premier League Classics](https://eriusports.com/collections/premier-league-classics)
- [European & World Classics](https://eriusports.com/collections/european-world-classics)
- [Kids Football Kits](https://eriusports.com/collections/kids-football-kits): shirt and shorts, ages 2 to 13
- [GAA Jerseys](https://eriusports.com/collections/gaa-jerseys): county jerseys, €29.95, player fit, S to 2XL. 2026 jerseys for Dublin, Louth, Tipperary, Tyrone and Wexford, alternative jerseys for Down and Antrim, and goalkeeper jerseys including Limerick, Mayo and Galway. Each county has its own page, e.g. [Louth](https://eriusports.com/clubs/louth)
- [GAA Training Vests](https://eriusports.com/collections/gaa-training-vests)
- [AFL Jerseys](https://eriusports.com/collections/afl-jerseys)
- [Shop by club](https://eriusports.com/clubs) and [by player](https://eriusports.com/players): shirts printed with the name and number the player wore, e.g. [Ronaldinho](https://eriusports.com/players/ronaldinho) (PSG, Barcelona, AC Milan), [Ronaldo Nazário](https://eriusports.com/players/ronaldo-nazario) (PSV, Brazil, Inter, Real Madrid, AC Milan), [Thierry Henry](https://eriusports.com/players/thierry-henry) (Arsenal 14) and [Troy Parrott](https://eriusports.com/players/troy-parrott) (Ireland 7, Real Betis 19)
